story_text:
## Featured on!
[画像: Featured on!]
## 4 Reasons to Choose TonoCard
[画像: 4 Reasons to Choose TonoCard]
## You’re Busy. TonoCard Answers.
[画像: You’re Busy. TonoCard Answers.]
When you’re busy, TonoCard answers for you and captures the key details. Keep your attention on what matters, then catch up when you’re ready.
Watch TonoCard answer a call, ask who is calling and why, alert the user, and hand the conversation back. Then see the call recap in the companion app.
TonoCard answers incoming calls, asks what callers need, and responds according to your settings. It alerts you when your attention is needed.
## Important Call Alerts. Take Over Anytime.
[画像: Important Call Alerts. Take Over Anytime.]
TonoCard lights up and vibrates when a call needs your attention. Want to step in while AI is answering? Press the card’s button to take over—no hanging up or calling back.
[画像: Important Call Alerts. Take Over Anytime.]
## Your Voice. Your Rules.
Choose your AI’s voice, including a clone of your own, and set the rules it follows. Decide what it asks and when it alerts you.
Let TonoCard answer calls in your cloned voice—or in a preset voice you choose.
TonoCard follows the instructions you set—not just how to speak, but what to ask and how to respond. It answers according to your rules, gathers the details you need, and alerts you when a conversation needs your attention.
[画像: You Set the Rules.]
## From To-Do to Done.
[画像: From To-Do to Done.]
Ask about opening hours, check appointment details, or inquire about a service. Give an AI assistant a calling task and have it contact the other party and report back, so you can decide what comes next.
## Smarter with Every Call.
TonoCard lets your AI agent handle real-world tasks over the phone. It brings your saved preferences and relevant context into conversations, then turns them into clear summaries and useful next steps.
Connect TonoCard to your AI agent and let it make calls on your behalf—from booking appointments and reservations to arranging services and follow-ups.
Review who called, what they needed, and the key points of the conversation in the app. Use the recap to catch up and plan your follow-up.
After calls, TonoCard analyzes its AI responses, builds a memory of your preferences, and refines future answering strategies.
TonoCard handles everyday calls in major languages worldwide, including German, Italian, French, Japanese, Arabic, and more.
## AI Answers Across Your Apps.
TonoCard supports voice calls on WeChat, WhatsApp, and LINE—bringing AI call handling to the apps you already use.
## Your Privacy. Your Control.
[画像: Your Privacy. Your Control.]
The TonoCard app puts you in control of your privacy. Review and delete call records, transcripts, recordings, and summaries stored locally on your phone. No account required.
## One Card. Built for Every Day.
Snap TonoCard onto your phone and connect via Bluetooth. Its slim design, built-in display, vibration alerts, and physical control keep your AI call assistant within easy reach.
Just 3.2 mm thin and 35 g light, TonoCard adds minimal bulk to your phone. With around 30 days of standby, it stays ready when you need it.
Pair TonoCard with your phone in the app, then choose your answering mode and response preferences. No sign-up or login required.
[画像: Easy to Connect. Easy to Set Up.]
Using Bluetooth to access your phone’s system audio, TonoCard can take over incoming phone calls and voice calls from most apps.
Pair TonoCard with up to three phones for flexible use across your work and personal devices.
## You Have More Than Calls to Answer.
[画像: 图片预览]
## Choose Your AI Plan.
[画像: Choose Your AI Plan.]
Explore TonoCard’s AI subscription plans, see what each option includes, and subscribe directly in the TonoCard app.

## About TonoCard
[画像: About TonoCard]
Longtree (Shenzhen) Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd. is a technology company focused on AI voice interaction and productivity hardware. Building on its expertise in real-time voice interaction, the company aims to bring AI beyond screens and software into the physical world, making natural speech an efficient way for people to interact with AI.
Longtree believes that AI voice technology should be integrated into everyday communication and workflows. Guided by this vision, it is developing an integrated hardware and software technology platform and exploring AI applications in areas such as telephone communications.

risks: TonoCard combines custom hardware, device firmware, Bluetooth communication, and a companion mobile app, so development and production may involve challenges related to hardware manufacturing, firmware stability, and system integration

faq.q: Does TonoCard support iOS and Android?
faq.a:
TonoCard supports iOS. Because Android phones vary widely in hardware and OS versions, the app experience may differ across devices.

If you use an Android phone, please contact our support team before purchasing. We’ll help you check compatibility with your phone model and OS version so you can make an informed decision.
Only the portion handled by the AI is recorded. The recording is saved locally in the app’s call details. Once you take over, recording stops, and the rest of the conversation is not recorded.

faq.q: Why does TonoCard attach to the back of your phone?
faq.a: Attach it and it’s ready to handle your calls—without a complicated setup or a new system to learn. There’s no need to dig through phone settings, and turning off Bluetooth stops it immediately. As a dedicated physical device, it remains visible and easy to control regardless of how your phone is configured.

faq.q: Can I set different call-answering rules for each of the three connected phones?
faq.a: Yes. Call-answering rules are configured separately for each phone, so every connected phone can have its own rules.

faq.q: Does TonoCard automatically record calls while the AI is answering?
faq.a: Yes, but only while the AI is handling the call. The recording is stored locally in the app and can be accessed from the call details. Once you take over, recording stops, and the rest of the conversation is not recorded.

faq.q: Does TonoCard require a separate SIM card or phone number?
faq.a: No. TonoCard connects to a compatible smartphone via Bluetooth 5.3, so no additional phone number is required.

faq.q: Can I take over while the AI is handling a call?
faq.a: Yes. When a call requires your attention, TonoCard alerts you so you can step in and continue the same call in real time.

faq.q: Does TonoCard automatically answer every call?
faq.a: No. You can customize its answering and screening rules, deciding which calls the AI should handle and when you should be notified.

faq.q: Can TonoCard make outgoing calls for me?
faq.a: Yes. Tell the AI whom to contact and what needs to be done. After you confirm the details, it can handle everyday calls such as inquiries, bookings, and confirmations, then report the result back to you.

faq.q: How can I review what happened after an AI-handled call?
faq.a: You can review the caller, purpose, key details, and follow-up items in the app’s call details, then call back with one tap. This information is stored locally.

faq.q: Can I choose the voice TonoCard uses to answer calls?
faq.a: Yes. You can choose from the available AI voices or use voice cloning after reviewing and accepting the relevant Privacy Policy and Terms of Service. These terms are presented when you first open the app and set up TonoCard. For details on how voice data is processed and protected, please refer to the TonoCard Privacy Policy.

updates.title: TonoCard Is Fully Funded. You Made It Happen. 🎉
updates.text:
Some moments deserve your full attention—a conversation across the dinner table, a meeting that matters, or simply a little time to yourself.
But your phone doesn’t know when those moments are happening.
That’s why we created TonoCard: to handle the call when you’re busy, while keeping you in control. It answers according to your instructions, lets you follow along with live transcripts, and gives you the option to take over whenever you choose.
